_doc: Known findings of scripts/test-vessel-vertices.mjs. key = part id | kind. value = worst measured value (spike: mm; swollen: ratio; detached: mm). The list may only shrink.

FJ1976-END|spike.reason: the piece reads its weights on the centreline of each tube, the vessel on its surface (or is moved by a solver): where the field is steep the two slip a few millimetres at the extreme pose. No thorns, the tube keeps its shape.
